source.check: the unopposed returns in the Ulster Herald of 20 May 1961, p. 7, and the returning officer's notice of result in the same paper of 10 June 1961, p. 4.

note: Triennial election of Omagh Rural District Council, polled Thursday 1 June 1961. There was no contest in the district: all 39 members were returned unopposed after Mr. Fred Giboney withdrew in Bencran. Returned unopposed. Returned unopposed.
